name: AI Grandma Parkour: Your Grandma (or Grandpa) Does the Stunts
blurb: AI grandma stunt videos show an older person moving like a pro.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 12 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
12s, 9:16 vertical, premium cinematic parkour showcase, photorealistic, intense, fast and athletic.

The freerunner is the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), and the clothes from [Image 1], with sneakers, so the family recognizes them at once. Keep their age exactly as in [Image 1]: the joke is an older person who moves like a pro. If they wear a headscarf, a long skirt or a cardigan in [Image 1], it stays, worn with dignity. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the performer is that animal, with its own face, fur and markings. The same real person in every frame, from the first second to the last. Never morph, never a younger face, never a different person.

A freerunner [Image 1] races through a sunny concrete plaza: wide concrete steps, low and high concrete walls, ledges and metal railings, pale concrete buildings and a clear blue sky behind; a few adult bystanders on the steps hold up their phones. Realistic anatomy, balance, impact and physics. No slow motion. ONE CONTINUOUS RUN. Same athlete, outfit and direction. No cuts, teleportation, duplicated limbs, body deformation or impossible jumps.
0–2s: Medium shot: the person rolls their shoulders, shakes out their legs and looks into the camera with a calm, confident face, large and sharp. The bystanders whisper, worried.
2–5s: Low tracking camera beside the athlete sprinting across the plaza. They dive over a low concrete wall with a fast Dive Kong Vault: both hands plant on top, the body flies flat over the wall, they land on their feet and keep running.
5–8s: Side camera follows as they clear a second, higher concrete wall with a powerful Kong Vault, the body stretched flat in the air, landing smoothly.
8–10s: Frontal tracking shot. They dive head first over a third wall with a long Dive Kong and land light on both feet.
10–12s: They stop in front of the camera, raise both arms and laugh, proud; the bystanders clap and cheer. The face is large, sharp and clearly the face from [Image 1].
Audio: footsteps, hands slapping concrete, gasps, then clapping and cheering. One bystander's voice, the same person all through, real and close by, not a narrator: worried at first ("Grandma, please stop!"), amazed at the end ("YES! You did it, Grandma!"). Say "Grandpa" instead of "Grandma" if [Image 1] shows a man. No background music.
Exactly one athlete. No falls, no stumbles, no injuries: every landing is clean and strong. No text, no subtitles, no logos on the clothes or shoes, no watermark.
